title: Fallback
description: Providers a stage switches to, in order, when its own provider fails mid-session. The LLM switches only before any token of the reply was sent; TTS switches for the next utterance, never mid-word. STT has no fallback: switching recognizers mid-utterance corrupts the transcript and turn state, so an STT failure degrades the session instead. Each fallback must serve the session's language. An empty list is a slot that is off.

llm.description: LLM routes tried after agent.pipeline.llm, in order. A route identical to the primary is skipped.

tts.description: Voices tried after agent.pipeline.tts, in order. A different vendor speaks in a different voice, so a switch is heard.
